description: AdminClient always builds base_url as 'http://{addr}'. The Bearer token (from --token or STOA_CTL_TOKEN) is sent in the Authorization header over plain HTTP. If the admin port is exposed beyond loopback (e.g. on a management VLAN), the token can be sniffed. The default address is 127.0.0.1:9090 (loopback only), which is safe in practice. However the code has no mechanism to enforce HTTPS, and there is no warning if addr is non-loopback. Consider either adding TLS support or emitting a warning when addr is not a loopback address.
title: ctl: admin token sent over plain HTTP; stoa-ctl never uses HTTPS
